novel_features_built.name: Chrome session auth
novel_features_built.description: Import Google session cookies from Chrome without manual DevTools copying.
novel_features_built.rationale: NotebookLM has no public API key; cookie auth is the only practical agent path.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Use once after logging into Google in Chrome to enable all live commands.

novel_features_built.name: Offline notebook search
novel_features_built.description: Search synced notebooks locally by title or id without another API round-trip.
novel_features_built.rationale: Requires local SQLite cache populated by sync.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Use when you need fast recall across many notebooks in scripts.

novel_features_built.name: Grounded chat with citations
novel_features_built.description: Ask questions against notebook sources via streamed batchexecute RPC.
novel_features_built.rationale: Mirrors notebooklm-py chat wire format in a static Go binary.
novel_features_built.example: notebooklm-pp-cli chat ask "Research" "What are the main themes?" --json
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Use for agent loops that need cited answers from uploaded sources.

novel_features_built.name: Studio quiz generation
novel_features_built.description: Kick off NotebookLM Studio quiz artifact generation and optionally wait for completion.
novel_features_built.rationale: Wraps undocumented Studio RPCs not exposed by curl.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Use to produce study materials from a notebook's sources.

novel_features_built.name: Doctor health gate
novel_features_built.description: Validate config, cookie presence, and session bootstrap tokens before live calls.
novel_features_built.rationale: Agents need a deterministic preflight when cookies expire silently.
novel_features_built.why_it_matters: Run after auth login or when list commands return empty results.
